thread:
ana: hey team — i'm cleaning up the SDK docs for streaming examples. need to convert the sync snippets to async across py/ts/go and clarify retry+pagination behavior. anyone volunteering for a coordinated PR?

kevin: i can take the python + ts bits. quick q: do we want to show the legacy `for chunk in client.stream(...)` -> `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` pattern OR a helper wrapper?

ana: ana: probably both: show the minimal direct change and a recommended helper for backpressure. also add a note about retries not resetting an in-progress cursor.

kevin: ok. tentative plan: 
- short inline sync->async diff
- python helper `aiter_with_backpressure` (1-2 lines)
- ts example using `for await (const chunk of client.stream(...))` + `AbortController` snippet

liam: for pagination + retries: we should explicitly recommend storing page tokens on the client side and include pseudo-retry code. otherwise a retry after a partial stream could start the first page again. i have a tiny pseudo-code: 
```
// pseudocode
page = start_token
while True:
  try:
    for item in client.page_fetch(page):
      yield item
    page = next_page_token
  except transient_error:
    sleep(backoff)
    // do not reset page
    continue
```

kevin: nice. i'll adapt that into real examples for py/ts. for python streaming generator we'll show `async for chunk in client.stream(...):` and then `await process(chunk)` inside.

ana: (typo) ana: small gotcha: in python the client `.stream()` returns an async iterator only in the async SDK — call that out and show the synchronous variant briefly. add link to the migration guide.

doc-bot: PR template filled: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls/new?template=streaming-migration.md :eyes: Please include QA checklist and mention `edge-case: pagination + retry` in PR body.

kevin: i'm going to push a draft branch `docs/async-streaming-examples` with py and ts examples. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

sophia: i'll do the go example and the doc note about `client.Seek()` behavior during partial retries. go snippet idea: use `chan` + goroutine to read stream and a context for cancel. sample: 
```
ch := make(chan Chunk)
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
go func() {
  defer close(ch)
  err := client.Stream(ctx, func(c Chunk) error { ch <- c; return nil })
  if err != nil { /* handle */ }
}()
for c := range ch {
  process(c)
}
```

liam: perfect. can you add a short paragraph about preserving `pageToken` across retries and an example test case?

sophia: yep, i'll add unit tests and a sample replay test showing partial stream failure + resume. i'll open PR and tag `@docs-review` once done.

kevin: thanks — i'll coordinate so we don't step on each other. planning to include a tiny migration checklist: `- verify async iterator returns, - update samples, - add tests for retry/pagination`.

ana: great. once both PRs are draft'ed let's consolidate and run the docs-link-checker.

sophia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4273 — draft, includes go snippet and tests. tagging reviewers. :rocket:

kevin: draft pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4274 (py + ts) — left TODO to add a short section on backpressure.

ana: :raised_hands: awesome. i'll review both tomorrow morning and then we can merge together after quick smoke.
